{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CegEQSUtfwoRFW3vzQSgd","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01NhPHDXdL3tZvRCQe4G2KtN","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/nbody_claude-sonnet-5-cc-medium_hybrid_r1/nbody/nbody.cpp","content":"#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;\nconstexpr double DT = 0.01;\nconstexpr int BLOCK_SIZE = 256;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                 \\\n    do {                                                                                 \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                                      \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                                      \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,             \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err__));                                          \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                \\\n        }                                                                                 \\\n    } while (0)\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    // Kept strictly sequential: matches the original reference implementation\n    // bit-for-bit so results/hashes are unaffected by the parallelization below.\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Tiled all-pairs force kernel. The j-loop walks bodies 0..n-1 in strictly\n// increasing order (tile by tile, then within a tile), so the floating-point\n// summation order for each body i is identical to the original serial code.\n__global__ void computeForcesKernel(const double* __restrict__ posx,\n                                     const double* __restrict__ posy,\n                                     const double* __restrict__ posz,\n                                     double* __restrict__ velx,\n                                     double* __restrict__ vely,\n                                     double* __restrict__ velz,\n                                     int n, int start, int count) {\n    extern __shared__ double3 shPos[];\n\n    const int localIdx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const bool active = localIdx < count;\n    const int i = start + localIdx;\n\n    double xi = 0.0, yi = 0.0, zi = 0.0;\n    if (active) {\n        xi = posx[i];\n        yi = posy[i];\n        zi = posz[i];\n    }\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n    for (int tile = 0; tile < n; tile += blockDim.x) {\n        const int idx = tile + threadIdx.x;\n        if (idx < n) {\n            shPos[threadIdx.x] = make_double3(posx[idx], posy[idx], posz[idx]);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int tileSize = min((int)blockDim.x, n - tile);\n        if (active) {\n            for (int k = 0; k < tileSize; ++k) {\n                const double dx = shPos[k].x - xi;\n                const double dy = shPos[k].y - yi;\n                const double dz = shPos[k].z - zi;\n                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n                Fx += dx * invDist3;\n                Fy += dy * invDist3;\n                Fz += dz * invDist3;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        velx[i] += DT * Fx;\n        vely[i] += DT * Fy;\n        velz[i] += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void integrateBodiesKernel(double* __restrict__ posx,\n                                       double* __restrict__ posy,\n                                       double* __restrict__ posz,\n                                       const double* __restrict__ velx,\n                                       const double* __restrict__ vely,\n                                       const double* __restrict__ velz,\n                                       int start, int count) {\n    const int localIdx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (localIdx >= count) return;\n    const int i = start + localIdx;\n    posx[i] += velx[i] * DT;\n    posy[i] += vely[i] * DT;\n    posz[i] += velz[i] * DT;\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    #pragma omp parallel for reduction(+:energy) schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const auto& body = bodies[i];\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x +\n                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y +\n                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    #pragma omp parallel for reduction(+:energy) schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n    int failures = 0;\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for reduction(+:failures) schedule(static)\n    for (size_t idx = 0; idx < n; ++idx) {\n        const auto& body = bodies[idx];\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {\n            ++failures;\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;\nconstexpr double DT = 0.01;\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n        \n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n            \n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        \n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;\n        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;\n        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;\n        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;\n        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n    \n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + \n                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y + \n                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n    \n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") numBodies);\n    printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Initialize bodies\n    std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);\n    randomizeBodies(bodies);\n    \n    // Run simulation\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForces(bodies);\n        integrateBodies(bodies);\n    }\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if constexpr Vec3(double x=0,double y=0,double z=0) noexcept:x(x),y(y),z(z){} };\nstruct Body { Vec3 pos; Vec3 vel; };\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed=42){\n    for (auto& body: bodies){\n        body.pos.x=2.0*(rand_r(&seed)/(double)RAND_MAX)-1.0;\n        body.pos.y=2.0*(rand_r(&seed)/(double)RAND_MAX)-1.0;\n        body.pos.z=2.0*(rand_r(&seed)/(double)RAND_MAX)-1.0;\n        body.vel.x=2.0*(rand_r(&seed)/(double)RAND_MAX)-1.0;\n        body.vel.y=2.0*(rand_r(&seed)/(double)RAND_MAX)-1.0;\n        body.vel.z=2.0*(rand_r(&seed)/(double)RAND_MAX)-1.0;\n    }\n}\nvoid computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies){\n    const size_t n=bodies.size();\n    for(size_t i=0;i<n;++i){\n        double Fx=0,Fy=0,Fz=0;\n        for(size_t j=0;j<n;++j){\n            double dx=bodies[j].pos.x-bodies[i].pos.x;\n            double dy=bodies[j].pos.y-bodies[i].pos.y;\n            double dz=bodies[j].pos.z-bodies[i].pos.z;\n            double distSqr=dx*dx+dy*dy+dz*dz+SOFTENING;\n            double invDist=1.0/std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            double invDist3=invDist*invDist*invDist;\n            Fx+=dx*invDist3; Fy+=dy*invDist3; Fz+=dz*invDist3;\n        }\n        bodies[i].vel.x+=DT*Fx; bodies[i].vel.y+=DT*Fy; bodies[i].vel.z+=DT*Fz;\n    }\n}\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies){\n    for(auto& body:bodies){ body.pos.x+=body.vel.x*DT;
